testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect a command context menu in the Sketch Constrain expansion: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:37:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect a command context menu in the Sketch Constrain expansion ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with an active editable `Sketch1` in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full Sketch ribbon is visible ✔ And the Constrain additional command area is open ✔ When the user right-clicks Edit Coordinate System ✔ Then the command context menu lists Ribbon Appearance, Add to Quick Access Toolbar, Move to Main Panel, Show Panels, Customize User Commands, Undock Ribbon and Docking Positions ✔ And the Constrain additional command area remains open ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the command context menu closes ✔ And the Constrain additional command area remains open ✔ And the Edit Coordinate System help tooltip appears while the pointer remains over that command ✔ And the editable sketch remains active and unchanged
